rules.description: App-specific cache files in your home Library. Apps regenerate these on next launch.
rules.restoreHint: Apps rebuild their caches automatically on next launch.

rules.description: System-level cache files. Requires the privileged helper.
rules.restoreHint: Rebuilt automatically by macOS.

rules.description: Application diagnostic logs in your home Library.
rules.restoreHint: Apps write fresh logs as needed.

rules.description: Build intermediates Xcode regenerates on next build. Often 10+ GB for active developers.
rules.restoreHint: Regenerated on your next Xcode build.

rules.description: Symbol files for iOS versions older than the current major. Re-downloaded on demand.
rules.restoreHint: Re-downloaded when you next attach a device on that iOS version.

rules.description: Old build archives. Recent ones are kept for crash symbolication.
rules.restoreHint: Cannot be regenerated — only delete archives you no longer need to symbolicate.

rules.description: Simulator runtime caches. Does NOT touch your installed simulators or their data.
rules.restoreHint: Rebuilt automatically when you next launch a simulator.

rules.description: Downloaded npm package tarballs. Re-fetched from the registry when needed.
rules.restoreHint: Re-downloaded on your next `npm install`.

rules.description: Downloaded Yarn package archives across all projects.
rules.restoreHint: Re-downloaded on your next `yarn install`.

rules.description: Cached dependencies and build outputs shared across Gradle projects.
rules.restoreHint: Re-downloaded on your next Gradle build.

rules.description: Gradle binaries downloaded by the wrapper for each project's Gradle version.
rules.restoreHint: Re-downloaded by the Gradle wrapper on next build.

rules.description: JDK toolchains auto-provisioned by Gradle.
rules.restoreHint: Re-downloaded by Gradle toolchain provisioning when needed.

rules.description: Android build caches and incomplete SDK downloads.
rules.restoreHint: Rebuilt or re-downloaded by Android Studio.

rules.description: Each Android Virtual Device disk image. These belong to specific projects — review before removing.
rules.restoreHint: Recreate in Android Studio → Device Manager.

rules.description: Global package store shared by all Flutter/Dart projects. Deleting forces re-download for every project.
rules.restoreHint: Re-downloaded on your next `flutter pub get`.

rules.description: Local Maven dependency cache shared by all Java projects.
rules.restoreHint: Re-downloaded on your next Maven build.

rules.description: Downloaded pod specs and sources cached across projects.
rules.restoreHint: Re-downloaded on your next `pod install`.

rules.description: Cached web content. Doesn't affect bookmarks, history, or saved passwords.
rules.restoreHint: Safari re-caches pages as you browse.

rules.description: Cached web content for every Chrome profile.
rules.restoreHint: Chrome re-caches pages as you browse.

rules.description: Cached web content for every Firefox profile.
rules.restoreHint: Firefox re-caches pages as you browse.

rules.description: Attachments downloaded by Mail.app. Originals remain on the server.
rules.restoreHint: Re-download from the original message anytime.
